description: The trail of what happened to bookings — held, confirmed, cancelled, expired — newest first, with who did it. Use it to answer "what happened to this booking"; an actor of `system` is the server freeing an expired hold, not a person. Each row is immutable, so this is the record even when the booking itself is gone.

limit.description: How many rows, newest first. Default 100

productId.description: Narrow to one product. Omit for the whole company

name: hub_get_booking_events
title: Read booking history
